100                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Provides a formula interface to 'ggplot2' graphics.
101                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Unified plotting tools for statistics commonly used, such as GLM,\n    time series, PCA families, clustering and survival analysis. The package offers\n    a single plotting interface for these analysis results and plots in a unified\n    style using 'ggplot2'.
102                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       A 'ggplot2' extension that supports arbitrary \n    hand-crafted colourable & fillable shapes. New shapes may be feature \n    requested via a Github issue.
103                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Useful functions and utilities for 'ggplot' object (e.g., geometric layers, themes, and utilities to edit the object).
104                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Provides a range of filters that can be applied to layers from the\n    'ggplot2' package and its extensions, along with other graphic elements such\n    as guides and theme elements. The filters are applied at render time and\n    thus uses the exact pixel dimensions needed.
105                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The function gggap() streamlines the creation of segments on\n    the y-axis of 'ggplot2' plots which is otherwise not a trivial task to\n    accomplish.
106 A variety of multivariable data summary statistics and \n    constructions have been proposed, either to generalize univariable analogs \n    or to exploit multivariable properties.\n    Notable among these are the bivariate peelings surveyed by Green \n    (1981, ISBN:978-0-471-28039-2),\n    the bag-and-bolster plots proposed by Rousseeuw &al (1999) \n    <doi:10.1080/00031305.1999.10474494>, and the minimum spanning trees used by\n    Jolliffe (2002) <doi:10.1007/b98835> to represent high-dimensional \n    relationships among data in a low-dimensional plot.\n    Additionally, biplots of singular value--decomposed tabular data, such as\n    from principal components analysis, make use of vectors, calibrated axes,\n    and other representations of variable elements to complement point markers\n    for case elements; see Gabriel (1971) <doi:10.1093/biomet/58.3.453> and\n    Gower & Harding (1988) <doi:10.1093/biomet/75.3.445> for original proposals.\n    Because they treat the abscissa and ordinate as commensurate or the data\n    elements themselves as point masses or unit vectors, these multivariable\n    tools can be thought of as belonging to geometric data analysis; see Podani\n    (2000, ISBN:90-5782-067-6) for techniques and applications and Le Roux &\n    Rouanet (2005) <doi:10.1007/1-4020-2236-0> for foundations. 'gggda' extends\n    Wickham's (2010) <doi:10.1198/jcgs.2009.07098> layered grammar of graphics\n    with statistical transformation ("stat") and geometric construction ("geom")\n    layers for many of these tools, as well as convenience coordinate systems\n    to emphasize intrinsic geometry of the data.
107                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 A 'ggplot2' extension for drawing gene arrow maps.
108                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    An extension of 'ggplot2' for creating complex genomic\n maps. It builds on the power of 'ggplot2' and 'tidyverse' adding new 'ggplot2'-style\n geoms & positions and 'dplyr'-style verbs to manipulate the underlying data. It\n implements a layout concept inspired by 'ggraph' and introduces tracks to bring\n tidiness to the mess that is genomics data.
109                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Creates a reproducible 'ggplot2' object by storing the data and calls. 
110                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Moon charts are like pie charts except that the proportions are\n    shown as crescent or gibbous portions of a circle, like the lit and unlit\n    portions of the moon. As such, they work best with only one or two groups.\n    'gggibbous' extends 'ggplot2' to allow for plotting multiple moon charts in\n    a single panel and does not require a square coordinate system.
111                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         An extension of 'ggplot2' that makes it easy to add\n             raw 'grid' output, such as customised annotations, to a \n             'ggplot2' plot.  
112                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Provides one-liner functions for common legend and guide operations\n    in 'ggplot2'. Simplifies legend positioning, styling, wrapping, and\n    collection across multi-panel plots created with 'patchwork' or 'cowplot'.
113                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A 'ggplot2' extension that does a variety of little\n    helpful things.  The package extends 'ggplot2' facets through\n    customisation, by setting individual scales per panel, resizing panels\n    and providing nested facets.  Also allows multiple colour and fill\n    scales per plot. Also hosts a smaller collection of stats, geoms and axis \n    guides.
114                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Reproduce the halfnorm() function found in the 'faraway' package \n    using the 'ggplot2' API.
115                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   A Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) theme, color palettes, and\n    scales for 'ggplot2' to allow users to easily follow the HDX visual design\n    guide, including convenience functions for for loading and using the\n    Source Sans 3 font.
116                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Create hexagonal heatmaps with 'ggplot2',\n    using the 'size' aesthetic to variably size each hexagon.
117                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Make it easier to explore data with highlights.
118                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Provides a 'ggplot2' extension for drawing Hinton diagrams,\n    a visualisation technique for numerical matrices in which the area of\n    each square is proportional to the magnitude of the corresponding entry.\n    For signed data, white squares indicate positive values and black squares\n    indicate negative values on a grey background. Hinton diagrams are\n    especially useful for visualising PCA weight matrices, correlation matrices, \n    and transition matrices.
119                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Wrapper around geom_histogram() of 'ggplot2' to plot the histogram of a numeric vector. This is especially useful, since qplot() was deprecated in 'ggplot2' 3.4.0.
120                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       A user-friendly, highly customizable R package for building\n    horizon plots in the 'ggplot2' environment.
121                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   Splits date and time of day components from\n    continuous 'datetime' objects, then plots them using grammar\n    of graphics ('ggplot2'). Plots can also be decorated with\n    solar cycle information (e.g., sunset, sunrise, etc.).\n    This is useful for visualising data that are associated with\n    the solar cycle.
122                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Supports image files and graphic objects to be visualized in\n    'ggplot2' graphic system.
123                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Provides two new layer types for displaying image data as layers\n  within the Grammar of Graphics framework. Displays images using either a\n  rectangle interface, with a fixed bounding box, or a point interface using a\n  central point and general size parameter. Images can be given as local\n  JPEG or PNG files, external resources, or as a list column containing\n  raster image data.
124                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Provide specialized 'ggplot2' layers and scales for spatial\n    uncertainty visualization, including bivariate choropleth maps, pixel maps,\n    glyph maps, and exceedance probability maps.
125                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Visualise the results of F test to compare two variances, Student's t-test, test of equal or given proportions, Pearson's chi-squared test for count data and test for association/correlation between paired samples.
126                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Extensions to 'ggplot2' providing low-level debug tools: statistics\n    and geometries echoing their data argument. Layer manipulation: deletion,\n    insertion, extraction and reordering of layers. Deletion of unused variables\n    from the data object embedded in "ggplot" objects.
127                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Extends 'ggplot2' for visualizing interval-valued data with\n    scatter plots, histograms, index plots, boxplots, radar plots, PCA\n    displays, and correlation heatmaps. The package also converts\n    classical data tables into interval-valued data using clustering\n    algorithms or user-defined groupings.
128                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               A 'ggplot2' extension that enables visualization of IP\n    (Internet Protocol) addresses and networks. The address space is\n    mapped onto the Cartesian coordinate system using a space-filling\n    curve. Offers full support for both IPv4 and IPv6 (Internet Protocol\n    versions 4 and 6) address spaces.
129                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Create interactive 'ggplot2' graphics using 'htmlwidgets'.
130                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Collection of functions to enhance 'ggplot2' and 'ggiraph'. Provides functions for exploratory plots.\n    All plot can be a 'static' plot or an 'interactive' plot using 'ggiraph'.
131                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Provides stat_isotonic() to add weighted univariate isotonic regression curves.
132                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           A unified algorithm, blockwise-majorization-descent (BMD), for efficiently computing the solution paths of the group-lasso penalized least squares, logistic regression, Huberized SVM and squared SVM. The package is an implementation of Yang, Y. and Zou, H. (2015) <doi:10.1007/s11222-014-9498-5>.
133                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Provides multiple palettes based on pride flags with tailored themes.
134                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Visualise overlapping time series lines as a heatmap of line\n    density. Provides a 'ggplot2' statistic implementing the DenseLines\n    algorithm, which "normalizes time series by the arc length to compute\n    accurate densities"\n    (Moritz and Fisher, 2018) <doi:10.48550/arXiv.1808.06019>.
135                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Allows for easy creation of diagnostic plots for a variety of model objects using the Grammar of Graphics.  \n  Provides functionality for both individual diagnostic plots and an array of four standard diagnostic plots.
136                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Provides a way to log 'ggplot' component calls, which can be\n    useful for debugging and understanding how 'ggplot' objects are created.\n    The logged calls can be printed, saved, and re-executed to reproduce the\n    original 'ggplot' object.
137                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Provides statistical transformations for plotting empirical \n    ordinary Lorenz curve (Lorenz 1905) <doi:10.2307/2276207> and \n    generalized Lorenz curve (Shorrocks 1983) <doi:10.2307/2554117>.
138                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Plot glycans following the Symbol Nomenclature for Glycans (SNFG) \n    using 'ggplot2'. SNFG provides a standardized visual representation of \n    glycan structures. 
139                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Create network-style visualizations of pairwise relationships\n    using custom edge glyphs built on top of 'ggplot2'. The package\n    supports both statistical and non-statistical data and allows users to\n    represent directed relationships. This enables clear,\n    publication-ready graphics for exploring and communicating relational\n    structures in a wide range of domains. The method was first used in\n    Abu-Akel et al. (2021) <doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0245100>. Code is\n    released under the MIT License; included datasets are licensed under\n    the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
140                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Provides functions for defining \n    mixed graphs containing three types of edges, directed, \n    undirected and bi-directed, with possibly multiple edges.\n    These graphs are useful because they capture fundamental\n    independence structures in multivariate distributions\n    and in the induced distributions after marginalization \n    and conditioning.\n    The package is especially concerned with Gaussian graphical\n    models for\n    (i) ML estimation for directed acyclic graphs, undirected and \n    bi-directed graphs and ancestral graph models\n    (ii) testing several conditional independencies\n    (iii) checking global identification of DAG Gaussian models\n    with one latent variable\n    (iv) testing Markov equivalences and generating Markov \n    equivalent graphs of specific types.
141                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       A collection of functions to visualize spatial data and models\n    on top of static maps from various online sources (e.g Google Maps and Stamen\n    Maps). It includes tools common to those tasks, including functions for\n    geolocation and routing.
142                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A 'ggplot2' extension centered on map visualization of China\n    and the globe. Provides customizable projections, boundary styles,\n    coordinate grids, scale bars, and buffer zones for thematic maps,\n    suitable for spatial data analysis and cartographic visualization.
143                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Helper to add insets based on geom_sf() from 'ggplot2'.\n    This package gives you a drop-in replacement for geom_sf() that supports\n    adding a zoomed inset map without having to create and embed a separate plot.
144                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 A quick and easy way of plotting the columns of two matrices or \n    data frames against each other using 'ggplot2'. Although 'ggmatplot' doesn't \n    provide the same flexibility as 'ggplot2', it can be used as a workaround for \n    having to wrangle wide format data into long format for plotting with\n    'ggplot2'.
145                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Tools for assessing and diagnosing convergence of\n    Markov Chain Monte Carlo simulations, as well as for graphically display\n    results from full MCMC analysis. The package also facilitates the graphical\n    interpretation of models by providing flexible functions to plot the\n    results against observed variables, and functions to work with\n    hierarchical/multilevel batches of parameters\n    (Fernández-i-Marín, 2016 <doi:10.18637/jss.v070.i09>).
146                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Enhance a 'mice' imputation workflow with visualizations for\n    incomplete and/or imputed data. The plotting functions produce\n    'ggplot' objects which may be easily manipulated or extended. Use\n    'ggmice' to inspect missing data, develop imputation models, evaluate\n    algorithmic convergence, or compare observed versus imputed data.
147                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Fit penalized multivariable linear mixed models with a single \n    random effect to control for population structure in genetic association \n    studies. The goal is to simultaneously fit many genetic variants at the \n    same time, in order to select markers that are independently associated \n    with the response. Can also handle prior annotation information, \n    for example, rare variants, in the form of variable weights. For more \n    information, see the website below and the accompanying paper: \n    Bhatnagar et al., "Simultaneous SNP selection and adjustment for \n    population structure in high dimensional prediction models", 2020, \n    <DOI:10.1371/journal.pgen.1008766>.
